synthetic_checks.note: FR14: an unlisted proceeding phrase never rejects and falls back to House-family treatment.
FR15: a leaf heading consisting only of the word Debate is treated as House-family; it must pass uncapped.

note: Public portion of the matrix. A further portion of cases, derived by the same published rules, is kept private for gating. Private Part 2 rows may use other House-family name forms that appear in the pack, on the same leaf types.
rulings_cited: Forum rulings FR1-FR21 (FR11 not issued), including R1 (class words) and the plural-chapter FR3 ruling. v1.2 changes no v1.1 expectation; see changelog.
changelog_v1_2: Two Part 2 public rows added (ids P2-1032, P2-1033): House-level leaf under a part heading naming a listed body, for "the House" and "the Chamber"; expected match (FR19).
No v1.1 expected outcome changed under FR16-FR21, R1 or the plural-chapter FR3 ruling.
FR3 chapter-title-only line is now informational: those caps are ruled correct (the plural chapter title is a committee signal).
